title: Queued ticket, case, consultation and reminder emails
summary: Ticket, case, consultation, and Staff Login reminder emails now send in the background, like sign-in and security emails already do.
changes: Send ticket, case, and consultation update emails through the background queue instead of during the page request.
Send the Staff Login reminder through the background queue.
Wait until a change is saved before sending its email, and skip the email if the record was deleted first.
version_rationale: Patch on the 0.42 line: emails keep the same content and recipients and now send from the queue.
validation: Ticket, case, consultation, and Staff Login reminder workflow tests.
composer pre-merge on the pull request branch.
known_limitations: Emails need the queue worker running; on Cloudron the run script starts it.
rollback: Redeploy the previous release package. No database change is involved.
